versos.hebraico: מִזְמ֗וֹר לְאָ֫סָ֥ף אַ֤ךְ ט֭וֹב לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל אֱלֹהִ֗ים לְבָרֵ֥י לֵבָֽב׃

controles.web: Surely God is good to Israel, to those who are pure in heart.
controles.kjv: Truly God is good to Israel, even to such as are of a clean heart.
controles.livre: Sim, certamente Deus é bom para Israel, para os limpos de coração.

versos.hebraico: וַאֲנִ֗י כִּ֭מְעַט נטוי רַגְלָ֑י כְּ֝אַ֗יִן שפכה אֲשֻׁרָֽי׃

controles.web: But as for me, my feet were almost gone. My steps had nearly slipped.
controles.kjv: But as for me, my feet were almost gone; my steps had well nigh slipped.
controles.livre: Eu porém, quase que meus pés se desviaram; quase nada faltou para meus passos escorregarem.

versos.hebraico: כִּֽי־קִ֭נֵּאתִי בַּֽהוֹלְלִ֑ים שְׁל֖וֹם רְשָׁעִ֣ים אֶרְאֶֽה׃

controles.web: For I was envious of the arrogant, when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.
controles.kjv: For I was envious at the foolish, when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.
controles.livre: Porque eu tinha inveja dos arrogantes, quando via a prosperidade dos perversos.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֤י אֵ֖ין חַרְצֻבּ֥וֹת לְמוֹתָ֗ם וּבָרִ֥יא אוּלָֽם׃

controles.web: For there are no struggles in their death, but their strength is firm.
controles.kjv: For there are no bands in their death: but their strength is firm.
controles.livre: Porque não há problemas para eles até sua morte, e o vigor deles continua firme.

versos.hebraico: בַּעֲמַ֣ל אֱנ֣וֹשׁ אֵינֵ֑מוֹ וְעִם־אָ֝דָ֗ם לֹ֣א יְנֻגָּֽעוּ׃

controles.web: They are free from burdens of men, neither are they plagued like other men.
controles.kjv: They are not in trouble as other men; neither are they plagued like other men.
controles.livre: Não são tão oprimidos como o homem comum, nem são afligidos como os outros homens;

versos.hebraico: לָ֭כֵן עֲנָקַ֣תְמוֹ גַאֲוָ֑ה יַעֲטָף־שִׁ֝֗ית חָמָ֥ס לָֽמוֹ׃

controles.web: Therefore pride is like a chain around their neck. Violence covers them like a garment.
controles.kjv: Therefore pride compasseth them about as a chain; violence covereth them as a garment.
controles.livre: Por isso eles são rodeados de arrogância como um colar; estão cobertos de violência como se fosse um vestido.

versos.hebraico: יָ֭צָא מֵחֵ֣לֶב עֵינֵ֑מוֹ עָ֝בְר֗וּ מַשְׂכִּיּ֥וֹת לֵבָֽב׃

controles.web: Their eyes bulge with fat. Their minds pass the limits of conceit.
controles.kjv: Their eyes stand out with fatness: they have more than heart could wish.
controles.livre: Seus olhos incham de gordura; são excessivos os desejos do coração deles.

versos.hebraico: יָמִ֤יקוּ׀ וִידַבְּר֣וּ בְרָ֣ע עֹ֑שֶׁק מִמָּר֥וֹם יְדַבֵּֽרוּ׃

controles.web: They scoff and speak with malice. In arrogance, they threaten oppression.
controles.kjv: They are corrupt, and speak wickedly concerning oppression: they speak loftily.
controles.livre: Eles são escarnecedores e oprimem falando mal e falando arrogantemente.

versos.hebraico: שַׁתּ֣וּ בַשָּׁמַ֣יִם פִּיהֶ֑ם וּ֝לְשׁוֹנָ֗ם תִּֽהֲלַ֥ךְ בָּאָֽרֶץ׃

controles.web: They have set their mouth in the heavens. Their tongue walks through the earth.
controles.kjv: They set their mouth against the heavens, and their tongue walketh through the earth.
controles.livre: Elevam suas bocas ao céu, e suas línguas andam na terra.

versos.hebraico: לָכֵ֤ן׀ ישיב עַמּ֣וֹ הֲלֹ֑ם וּמֵ֥י מָ֝לֵ֗א יִמָּ֥צוּ לָֽמוֹ׃

controles.web: Therefore their people return to them, and they drink up waters of abundance.
controles.kjv: Therefore his people return hither: and waters of a full cup are wrung out to them.
controles.livre: Por isso seu povo volta para cá, e as águas lhes são espremidas por completo.

versos.hebraico: וְֽאָמְר֗וּ אֵיכָ֥ה יָדַֽע־אֵ֑ל וְיֵ֖שׁ דֵּעָ֣ה בְעֶלְיֽוֹן׃

controles.web: They say, “How does God know? Is there knowledge in the Most High?”
controles.kjv: And they say, How doth God know? and is there knowledge in the most High?
controles.livre: E dizem: Como Deus saberia? Será que o Altíssimo tem conhecimento disto ?

versos.hebraico: הִנֵּה־אֵ֥לֶּה רְשָׁעִ֑ים וְשַׁלְוֵ֥י ע֝וֹלָ֗ם הִשְׂגּוּ־חָֽיִל׃

controles.web: Behold, these are the wicked. Being always at ease, they increase in riches.
controles.kjv: Behold, these are the ungodly, who prosper in the world; they increase in riches.
controles.livre: Eis que estes são perversos, sempre estão confortáveis e aumentam seus bens.

versos.hebraico: אַךְ־רִ֭יק זִכִּ֣יתִי לְבָבִ֑י וָאֶרְחַ֖ץ בְּנִקָּי֣וֹן כַּפָּֽי׃

controles.web: Surely in vain I have cleansed my heart, and washed my hands in innocence,
controles.kjv: Verily I have cleansed my heart in vain, and washed my hands in innocency.
controles.livre: Cheguei a pensar : Certamente purifiquei meu coração e lavei minhas mãos na inocência inutilmente,

versos.hebraico: וָאֱהִ֣י נָ֭גוּעַ כָּל־הַיּ֑וֹם וְ֝תוֹכַחְתִּ֗י לַבְּקָרִֽים׃

controles.web: For all day long have I been plagued, and punished every morning.
controles.kjv: For all the day long have I been plagued, and chastened every morning.
controles.livre: Porque sou afligido o dia todo, e castigado toda manhã.

versos.hebraico: אִם־אָ֭מַרְתִּי אֲסַפְּרָ֥ה כְמ֑וֹ הִנֵּ֤ה ד֭וֹר בָּנֶ֣יךָ בָגָֽדְתִּי׃

controles.web: If I had said, “I will speak thus”; behold, I would have betrayed the generation of your children.
controles.kjv: If I say, I will speak thus; behold, I should offend against the generation of thy children.
controles.livre: Se eu tivesse dito isto , eu falaria dessa maneira; eis que teria decepcionado a geração de teus filhos.

versos.hebraico: וָֽ֭אֲחַשְּׁבָה לָדַ֣עַת זֹ֑את עָמָ֖ל היא בְעֵינָֽי׃

controles.web: When I tried to understand this, it was too painful for me;
controles.kjv: When I thought to know this, it was too painful for me;
controles.livre: Quando tentei entender, isto me pareceu trabalhoso.

versos.hebraico: עַד־אָ֭בוֹא אֶל־מִקְדְּשֵׁי־אֵ֑ל אָ֝בִ֗ינָה לְאַחֲרִיתָֽם׃

controles.web: Until I entered God’s sanctuary, and considered their latter end.
controles.kjv: Until I went into the sanctuary of God; then understood I their end.
controles.livre: Até que entrei nos santuários de Deus, e entendi o fim de tais pessoas.

versos.hebraico: אַ֣ךְ בַּ֭חֲלָקוֹת תָּשִׁ֣ית לָ֑מוֹ הִ֝פַּלְתָּ֗ם לְמַשּׁוּאֽוֹת׃

controles.web: Surely you set them in slippery places. You throw them down to destruction.
controles.kjv: Surely thou didst set them in slippery places: thou castedst them down into destruction.
controles.livre: Certamente tu os fazes escorregarem, e os lança em assolações.

versos.hebraico: אֵ֤יךְ הָי֣וּ לְשַׁמָּ֣ה כְרָ֑גַע סָ֥פוּ תַ֝֗מּוּ מִן־בַּלָּהֽוֹת׃

controles.web: How they are suddenly destroyed! They are completely swept away with terrors.
controles.kjv: How are they brought into desolation, as in a moment! they are utterly consumed with terrors.
controles.livre: Como eles foram assolados tão repentinamente! Eles se acabaram, e se consumiram de medo.

versos.hebraico: כַּחֲל֥וֹם מֵהָקִ֑יץ אֲ֝דֹנָי בָּעִ֤יר׀ צַלְמָ֬ם תִּבְזֶֽה׃

controles.web: As a dream when one wakes up, so, Lord, when you awake, you will despise their fantasies.
controles.kjv: As a dream when one awaketh; so, O Lord, when thou awakest, thou shalt despise their image.
controles.livre: Como o sonho depois de acordar, ó Senhor, quando tu acordares desprezarás a aparência deles;

versos.hebraico: כִּ֭י יִתְחַמֵּ֣ץ לְבָבִ֑י וְ֝כִלְיוֹתַ֗י אֶשְׁתּוֹנָֽן׃

controles.web: For my soul was grieved. I was embittered in my heart.
controles.kjv: Thus my heart was grieved, and I was pricked in my reins.
controles.livre: Porque meu coração tem se amargurado, e meus rins têm sentido dolorosas picadas.

versos.hebraico: וַאֲנִי־בַ֭עַר וְלֹ֣א אֵדָ֑ע בְּ֝הֵמ֗וֹת הָיִ֥יתִי עִמָּֽךְ׃

controles.web: I was so senseless and ignorant. I was a brute beast before you.
controles.kjv: So foolish was I, and ignorant: I was as a beast before thee.
controles.livre: Então me comportei como tolo, e nada sabia; tornei-me como um animal para contigo.

versos.hebraico: וַאֲנִ֣י תָמִ֣יד עִמָּ֑ךְ אָ֝חַ֗זְתָּ בְּיַד־יְמִינִֽי׃

controles.web: Nevertheless, I am continually with you. You have held my right hand.
controles.kjv: Nevertheless I am continually with thee: thou hast holden me by my right hand.
controles.livre: Porém agora estarei continuamente contigo; tu tens segurado minha mão direita.

versos.hebraico: בַּעֲצָתְךָ֥ תַנְחֵ֑נִי וְ֝אַחַ֗ר כָּב֥וֹד תִּקָּחֵֽנִי׃

controles.web: You will guide me with your counsel, and afterward receive me to glory.
controles.kjv: Thou shalt guide me with thy counsel, and afterward receive me to glory.
controles.livre: Tu me guiarás com teu conselho, e depois me receberás em glória.

versos.hebraico: מִי־לִ֥י בַשָּׁמָ֑יִם וְ֝עִמְּךָ֗ לֹא־חָפַ֥צְתִּי בָאָֽרֶץ׃

controles.web: Whom do I have in heaven? There is no one on earth whom I desire besides you.
controles.kjv: Whom have I in heaven but thee? and there is none upon earth that I desire beside thee.
controles.livre: A quem tenho no céu além de ti ? E quando estou contigo, nada há na terra que eu deseje.

versos.hebraico: כָּלָ֥ה שְׁאֵרִ֗י וּלְבָ֫בִ֥י צוּר־לְבָבִ֥י וְחֶלְקִ֗י אֱלֹהִ֥ים לְעוֹלָֽם׃

controles.web: My flesh and my heart fails, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.
controles.kjv: My flesh and my heart faileth: but God is the strength of my heart, and my portion for ever.
controles.livre: Minha carne e meu coração desfalecem; porém Deus será a rocha do meu coração e minha porção para sempre.

versos.hebraico: כִּֽי־הִנֵּ֣ה רְחֵקֶ֣יךָ יֹאבֵ֑דוּ הִ֝צְמַ֗תָּה כָּל־זוֹנֶ֥ה מִמֶּֽךָּ׃

controles.web: For, behold, those who are far from you shall perish. You have destroyed all those who are unfaithful to you.
controles.kjv: For, lo, they that are far from thee shall perish: thou hast destroyed all them that go a whoring from thee.
controles.livre: Porque eis que os que ficaram longe de ti perecerão; tu destróis todo infiel a ti.

versos.hebraico: וַאֲנִ֤י׀ קִֽרֲבַ֥ת אֱלֹהִ֗ים לִ֫י־ט֥וֹב שַׁתִּ֤י׀ בַּאדֹנָ֣י יְהֹוִ֣ה מַחְסִ֑י לְ֝סַפֵּ֗ר כָּל־מַלְאֲכוֹתֶֽיךָ׃

controles.web: But it is good for me to come close to God. I have made the Lord Yahweh my refuge, that I may tell of all your works.
controles.kjv: But it is good for me to draw near to God: I have put my trust in the Lord God, that I may declare all thy works.
controles.livre: Mas quanto a mim, bom me é me aproximar de Deus; ponho minha confiança no Senhor DEUS, para que eu conte todas as tuas obras.
